description: RFC 8620 §5.5: if anchor is supplied and not found in the result set, the call MUST be rejected with anchorNotFound. If anchor IS found, anchorOffset is added to its index and used as position. All /query handlers (Email/query, Mailbox/query, EmailSubmission/query) never read the anchor or anchorOffset arguments — they are silently ignored. A client relying on anchor-based pagination (common in incremental sync) gets back wrong position=0 data with no error, a silent protocol violation. Fix: read anchor/anchorOffset in each query handler; return anchorNotFound if anchor is non-null and missing from results; compute effective position from anchor+offset if found.
title: anchor/anchorOffset silently ignored in all query handlers
